subtitle: "Every module, with its source and its result."
description: "Worked examples of the four Typst Extras modules, each with the source and the text it produces in the PDF."
---

The examples come from the [`example.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-typst-extras/blob/main/example.qmd) file in the repository and from the tests of the extension.
Render them with `quarto render example.qmd --to typst`.
This site renders HTML, so each section shows the source and the text that the Typst PDF contains.

## Lists of floats

```yaml
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: [tbl, lst]
```

The PDF starts the body with a list of tables and a list of listings:

```text
List of Tables
Table 1.1 A small table. . . . . 1
Table A.1 A table in the appendix. . . . . 1
List of Listings
Listing 1.1 A short script. . . . . 1
```

## Alternative text for formulas

```markdown
The energy is [$E = mc^2$]{alt="E equals m c squared"}.
```

The formula looks the same on the page.
The PDF now carries the alternative text, which a screen reader reads in place of the formula.

## Appendix and supplementary sections

```yaml
number-sections: true
crossref:
  chapters: true
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    sections:
      appendix-delimiter: "."
      supplementary-prefix: "S"
```

```markdown
# Method

A table with `chapters: true`: Table 1.1.

# Extra results {.appendix}

A table in the appendix: Table A.1.

# Raw data {.supplementary}

Supplementary text.
```

The PDF reads, in this order:

```text
1 Method
Table 1.1: A small table.
Appendix A — Extra results
Table A.1: A table in the appendix.
S1 Raw data
```

With `appendix-delimiter: ""`, the appendix table reads `Table A1`.

## Watermark

```yaml
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    watermark:
      text: "DRAFT"
      opacity: 15%
      angle: -45deg
      colour: gray
```

Every page carries the text `DRAFT`, in grey at 15% opacity and rotated by 45 degrees.
To use an image, replace `text` with `image: path/to/image.svg`, and fade the image file first.

The repository ships a short, standalone starting point you can copy: [`example.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-typst-extras/blob/main/example.qmd).
